section.title: omega tf variants
section.text:
RSI14: 14-period relative strength index (0–100). 3-period trajectory (t2 → … → now); RSI14_ltf_trend = direction over the window. VWAP: volume-weighted average price accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. dist_VWAP_ltf: % from current price to VWAP_ltf. EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA5_ltf_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5_ltf vs EMA13. ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100). ADX_ltf_zone: thresholded regime (overbought / oversold / neutral). close: the bar's close price. bar: whether the bar is still forming (live, provisional) or already closed (forming / closed). BBtouch: price contact with a Bollinger band (upper / lower / none). EMA5_13: the 5/13 EMA crossover event (Bullish / Bearish). MAalign: price stacked against EMA20 / SMA20 / SMA50 (bullish / bearish / mixed). zone: price location between the swing high and the swing low (breakout high / breakdown low / near high / near low / mid-range). ADX_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one. RVOL: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline).

ADX_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.
